name: Autonomous Lead Enrichment & Deep Research Pipeline

parameters.content: ### 🚀 Ingestion Layer\nAccepts webhook requests at `/webhook/lead-enrichment` or runs interactively via manual trigger.\nNormalizes domain, URL, company name, and lead contact email.

### 🔍 Dual-Path Enrichment\n- **Live Path**: When `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` or `SERPER_API_KEY` is configured, performs live web scrape & synthesis.\n- **Offline Path**: Built-in deterministic intelligence fixtures for zero-API resilient operation.
### 📊 ICP Scoring & Dossier Delivery\nComputes multi-dimensional ICP Fit Score (0-100), Intent Score (0-100), assigns Tier 1/2/3/4, generates Markdown dossier & JSON card, and responds with HTTP 200.
